summary: Post-market: the risk score stands at 42.82 (caution, goldilocks), up 0.44 on the day and the week. It was a strong risk-on session - the Dow jumped 1000 points, the S&P 500 hit records and oil tumbled on hopes of a Strait of Hormuz deal - led by a semis surge (AMD +8.76%, MU +8.01%, AVGO +7.03%, NVDA +2.92%) while VIX eased to 15.86. The offset is macro: the 10Y yield rose to 4.75% and the 10Y real rate to 2.47% (99.84th percentile), keeping macro the dominant risk. Breadth is healthy (87.5% above the 200-day average) but new-high participation is thin (0.25). Data coverage is degraded; model confidence is 0.77.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 10Y real rate of 2.47% (99.84th percentile) is the top macro risk driver, with the 10Y yield at 4.75% (98.65th percentile).
The 10Y-2Y curve at 0.47% keeps the macro term-structure backdrop stretched.
New-high participation is thin at 0.25 despite 87.5% of names above their 200-day average, leaving the record run without broad confirmation.
Semis relative strength of 10.05 concentrates momentum in one complex, raising unwind risk.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit remains benign - HY OAS 2.85 and IG OAS 0.79.
Volatility stayed calm: VIX 15.86, consistent with the goldilocks regime (low vol + positive momentum + healthy breadth).
Today's tape was strongly risk-on in semis: AMD +8.76%, MU +8.01%, AVGO +7.03%, NVDA +2.92%.

contradicting_signals.claim: Rates rose even on a risk-on day - the 10Y yield moved to 4.75% (from 4.68%) and the real rate to 2.47% (from 2.41%) - a tightening macro headwind at extremes.
Cross-asset confirmation is weak at 0.17 and memory-cost inflation is biting downstream (Apple downgraded), both at odds with the equity rally.

what_changed_today: Risk score rose to 42.82, up 0.44 on the day and the week.
10Y yield rose to 4.75% (from 4.68%) and the 10Y real rate to 2.47% (from 2.41%).
VIX eased to 15.86 (from 15.99); IG OAS edged down to 0.79 (from 0.80) while HY OAS ticked up to 2.85 (from 2.84).
Strong risk-on session: semis surged (AMD +8.76%, MU +8.01%, AVGO +7.03%, NVDA +2.92%), oil tumbled on Strait of Hormuz deal hopes and the S&P 500 set record highs.
watch_next: AMD earnings are due after today's close - a key test for chips and momentum stocks.
Hormuz Strait deal timing (Bessent flagged Tuesday or Wednesday) - oil and risk sentiment hinge on it.
Watch whether the new-highs ratio (0.25) expands to confirm the record-level index.

bull_case.title: Bull case: goldilocks regime extends
points: Calm volatility (VIX 15.86) with tight credit (HY OAS 2.85, IG OAS 0.79) and healthy breadth (87.5% above the 200-day average) supports further upside.
A pickup in the new-highs ratio from 0.25 would confirm the record run.

base_case.title: Base case: caution persists under a goldilocks tape
points: The score holds near 42.82 with macro the dominant risk and benign credit the offset.
Equities grind higher with the 200-day average as support (price vs MA200 +10.18%, 52-week drawdown 0.0).

bear_case.title: Bear case: rates break higher
points: A 10Y push beyond 4.75% with the real rate at 2.47% (99.84th percentile) would stress multiples.
Memory-cost inflation is already hitting downstream names (Apple downgraded) and a semis unwind would strike the market's largest relative winner (semis relative 10.05).
